skeptic.argument: All 3 must findings have concrete file:line evidence, while f-0004 (getDefaultMode lexical upward traversal loop) is likely falsifiable because path.resolve + path.dirname strips trailing segments purely lexically.

builder.argument: install.sh:95-106 and install.ps1:80-112 can both use CAVEMAN_SETTINGS_HELPER just like preflight and merge already do, and opencode/plugin.js can extract projectDir from ctx and gate experimental.chat.system.transform on getDefaultMode(projectDir) !== 'off'.

dreamer.argument: We should verify whether experimental.chat.system.transform also needs to strip any existing staleBlock when a user switches defaultMode to 'off' mid-session.

empath.argument: A developer who adds // comments to ~/.claude/settings.json and re-runs install.sh without --force expects an idempotent 'already installed' skip, not silent comment deletion.
